description: Andermatt sits on the floor of the Urseren valley, a compact village of stone and timber houses with the parish church tower among the roofs. Steep mountains close the valley on several sides. Late September here is tawny alpine grass and bare rock, not winter snow in the street. The frame is the village rather than the Schöllenen gorge, with no construction crane, under a partly cloudy and breezy Open-Meteo model, sun through broken cloud, and no precipitation.
